# Embedded fonts

Montserrat, Spectral and JetBrains Mono, Latin subsets (JetBrains Mono also Greek), as woff2 from the
`@fontsource` packages (version 5.3.0). All three are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the
licence texts are in this folder. `build_v55.py` embeds them in `proposal-v5.5.html` as base64, so the page
renders the same offline and on any PDF machine.
